criteria.frequent: dataset papers >= 10 (datasets by rule T1-1: spellings that differ only by punctuation are one dataset; the 'datasets used by 10+ papers' set of Analysis C)
criteria.diversity: dataset papers >= 3 and < 10, and every single-number value printed for it is >= 10,000 instances or every one is >= 100 features, printed in >= 2 papers; Analysis C found no entry of the 10+ set at or above these values
criteria.verification: a listed candidate or pool name that meets neither rule, or whose printed values are too sparse or inconsistent to place it
criteria.not_used: IR is not used to select candidates: definitions differ across papers (Analysis E); difficulty is not inferred from IR
criteria.pool: the 11 names listed in the task + every name meeting the frequent or diversity rule
criteria.label_status: approved by Toon (28 Oct 2026): group labels follow mechanically from the rules above (proposed by Claude 19 Oct 2026)
criteria.high_dim_note: No dataset used by at least 3 papers is printed with 100 or more features every time it is reported. This is a statement about this rule, not a finding that the corpus lacks high-dimensional data sets.
criteria.family_note: family = rule T1 (Toon, 28 Oct 2026): numbered or split versions belong to their main set; non-standard names are not merged; see build/family_rule.py
criteria.scope_note: the rule covers use frequency and printed size/dimensionality only; it does not establish diversity in overlap, noise, sparsity, feature type or any other characteristic

families.rule: T1 (Toon, 28 Oct 2026): names differing only by '-', '_', spaces or dots are one dataset; numbered or split versions belong to their main set's family; non-standard names are not merged (build/family_rule.py)
